input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal mechanics sit at our preferred position. § 8.2 provides automatic renewal in successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year renewal), a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice, and an express Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal (reinforced by an extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is not sent). § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. No other provision (including § 7 on Fees) contains renewal or uplift terms. Because every conditional automatic-renewal element is met, the preferred mutual-agreement requirement is not needed. No redline proposed.
